item.title: Lesson 1: Hermes Agent for Security and Automation: Profiles, Skills, and Bots Explained
item.description: Understand Hermes Agent and its parts — profiles, skills, memory, bots, the gateway, and the kanban board — and learn when the persistent model beats a per-project CLI coding agent.

item.title: Lesson 4: Auto-Routing AI Requests: Mix Local and Cloud Models Behind One API
item.description: Send one auto request and let the broker, not the agent, pick a local GPU model or a remote premium model using capability filtering, cost tiers, cascade, latency budgets, and placement pinning.

item.title: Lesson 7: Hermes Bot Profiles: Fan Work Out to Specialized Agents With a Kanban Dispatcher
item.description: Run one gateway with role-specific Hermes profiles, pin each to a model tier, split a job into dependent kanban cards, and verify every handoff before you trust it.

item.title: Lesson 8: Secure Your AI Broker: Virtual Keys, Budgets, and Allowed Models
item.description: Give each AI agent its own broker key with rate limits, token and cost budgets, and a fail-closed model allow-list, so one runaway caller stops at its own ceiling.
